title: Adding PLDM dissector for Base Specification
description:
This commit implemements PLDM dissector for the base specification of the protocol which is done following DMTF guideline documentation - https://www.dmtf.org/sites/default/files/standards/documents/DSP0240_1.1.0.pdf

Testing : For verification of dissector pcap file collected during host poweron is used.

Signed-off-by: Riya Dixit riyadixitagra@gmail.com

Hi Alexis @alagoutte  , I have split the dissector into different files as per the pldm spec commands it contains, after merging base pldm I have other specs of PLDM also in process for upstreaming. I suppose putting all this in one file will make maintenance and debugging difficult. What would you suggest considering this, I can try it? 
Thanks.

we have already a lot of file... and the number of line on your file is small < 1000

You can use comment for say, it is PDLM XXX, PDLM YYYY

You cannot have module globals (pldmTA, pldmTI) in a dissector. These have to be mapped onto a conversation.

Hi @JaapKeuter , I am a beginner. Can you please give me more insight about module globals and why they are required to be mapped onto a conversion. It would be great if you can point me to a Documentation which has details and more rules to be followed for future works. 
Thanks
